points.text: Is the Arabic text easy to read at phone size?
Does the layout read right to left, with the start of each row on the right?
Do the arrows and chevrons point the right way for Arabic?
Do the numbers read correctly, with digits and symbols in the right order?
Does the back arrow at the top point right?
Do all three cart items use the same arrangement of photo, name and price?
Does each quantity stepper show a minus, a number and a plus?
Does each of the subtotal, delivery, VAT and total rows show a label and an AED amount, with the amounts aligned to the same edge?
Is the total easy to pick out from the other rows?
Is the Place order button easy to spot and its label readable?
